artists.source_line: For information contact with DANCE TRAVEL:

features.rationale: The description says the event takes place in one hotel, which is also where the dancers stay.
The programme includes a pool party during the day.
Dance workshops are scheduled as part of the event.

features.quote: 2 rooms for the parties during the night
features.rationale: Two separate dance rooms are used for the night parties.
A pre-party is listed on the Wednesday programme.

features.quote: per person and day with FULL BOARD
features.rationale: The room prices are quoted with full board, so meals are included in the package.

features.quote: INFORMATION ABOUT SHUTTLE FROM BARCELONA AIRPORT OR GIRONA AIRPORT
features.rationale: Shuttle bus and train transfers from the airports to the hotel are described.
The description states that shows are part of the event.
